The name is often given to baby boys in the hope that they will grow up to be blessed and abundant in all aspects of their lives.

It is a reminder of the beauty and abundance of nature and the renewal and growth that it represents. The name is also said to be a symbol of the blessings of Allah and the abundant grace and mercy that He bestows upon us.
